Building a High-Energy Eating Plan 9
FACT OR FICTION
Quinoa is a superior whole grain.
The facts: Quinoa (which is actually a seed, although we eat it as a
grain) is touted as being a superior grain because it offers more protein
than other grains. But 200 calories (1/3 cup when uncooked) of quinoa
provides only 8 grams of protein; pasta offers 7 grams, and rice offers 4.
None are what | call protein powerhouses. Be sure to balance the meal
by combining quinoa with tofu, beans, or yogurt to reach the target of
20 to 30 grams of protein per meal. Quinoa is also expensive: $8 per
pound ($18/kg), as compared to brown rice at $1.50 per pound ($3.30/
kg). But it is quick cooking (less than 15 minutes), versatile, and a whole-
some addition to any meal.
